description: This file defines the EmployeeSkillService class, which provides service methods for managing employee skills in the HRM system. It primarily encapsulates access to the EmployeeSkillDao data access object.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillService
classes.description: Service class that manages employee skill data, providing getter and setter for the EmployeeSkillDao object.

methods.name: getEmployeeSkillDao
methods.description: Returns the instance of EmployeeSkillDao, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: setEmployeeSkillDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeSkillDao instance to be used by this service.
